text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black wool double-breasted thigh-length trench with epaulets and attached belt, black inner mini dress, sheer dark tights shown hollow, black high-heel ankle boots.
original_prompt: Edit this wardrobe product photograph. Remove all flesh-colored or anatomical legs inside the hosiery. Render empty translucent neutral gray-black pantyhose fabric, white backdrop visible through it, no skin, knees, calf anatomy or mannequin. Keep the hosiery pattern and all other clothes and shoes. Preserve all other materials and cuts, pure white background, fully uncropped portrait 2:3. No human, visible body, face, hair, mannequin, stand or new objects.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
